name: MediaOne: Photo&Video Viewer
vendor: MediaArt Studio (seller: Subin Mou / 苏斌 牟)
engine: AVFoundation (H.264 hardware decoding; mp4, mov, mpg, 3gp, vob)
summary: MediaOne (formerly ImageOne) is a Mac App Store media browser for photos, videos and audio that works on folders and Favorites without importing. It offers several thumbnail layouts, drive-wide search, star ratings and tags, compare view, video trimming, GIF export and batch conversion. Requires macOS 12.4.
where_it_wins: Hover-to-play previews and hover scrubbing of videos
Star ratings, tags, smart filters and photo map
Video trim, frame grab, video to GIF, batch image/video conversion
Drive-wide search with saved smart queries
where_schnellbild_wins: Plays MKV, WebM, AVI, WMV, FLV via built-in VLC
Opens ZIP/RAR/7z and CBZ/CBR as folders
Free with every feature, open source
HEIC, AVIF, JPEG XL, PSD, EXR, SVG and PDF
